snippet.title: SAND: Raiders Of Sophie | Release Date Announcement | Coming June 22
snippet.description:
Join the Server Slam and Wishlist now on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431300/Sand

SAND Launches on Steam on June 22!

Build your highly customizable walking base. Squad up or go solo. Gather loot, weapons, precious artifacts. Clash with other players in a brutal procedurally generated desert forged by history and chaos.

Developed by team Hologryph in Lviv, Ukraine. Support Ukraine - https://u24.gov.ua/

Wishlist SAND on console here:
XBOX Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9ng0ffht5mcb
Playstation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10010847
